nodes.label: Water Resources
nodes.subject: geography
nodes.detail: Vital renewable resource. 71% earth covered but only 2.7% fresh water. 70% of fresh water is ice in glaciers. Only 1% available for human use. Water can neither be added nor subtracted from earth.
